items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I loved Jimmy Noon; I loved to hear him... Jimmy Noon sold a lot of records too.

ctx.x: And it was just absolutely impossible to stay there at the time. And I was losing a lot of rest, I was losing weight I was down to, I guess, about 115 pounds, because I worked a full -- 3:00 o'clock in the morning and then go hear the musicians over at the Sunset and then I'd go across the street to the -- what was the name of that night club, I forget, now. Then I'd go here -- go there. I was listening to those New Orleans musicians so much, Jimmy Noon, and all of
them till I wasn't getting any rest, and I was losing a lot of rest.
